text: Before you trust anyone with a voyage.
How are you paid, and by whom?
sub: The line pays. After you sail.

text: A fee on top of the fare is a choice.
sub: Not a rule. Ask what it buys.

text: Which sailing would you talk me out of?
Can't name one? That is selling.
Who answers at 2am in my time zone?
sub: A name, not a call centre.
